- Dependencies: Network whitelisting (IT), SOC evidence review, procurement lead time

- Jamie Carter — VP Product (decision owner)
- Alex Nguyen — Director, IT (implementation contact)
- Procurement (TBD)

2) We lock owners inside the charter and update the timeline (we’ll share v1.1)
3) Redwood to provide a one-page SOW and PO template for procurement

Attachment: BH_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (engagement charter + milestone swimlane)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-minute follow-up if that helps.
